description: Athletic male figure reused by every exercise and camera (character 005, Kiệt 23/11): a MakeHuman (CC0) body whose shape below the neck is fitted to the sculpt 'Male base muscular anatomy' by CharacterZone (CC BY 4.0, level B), with a MakeHuman head (face 8b) and shorts from this pipeline.

body_shape.comment: MakeHuman macro sliders (0..1). Muscle definition is the MakeHuman (max muscle - average muscle) shape delta scaled by muscle_definition; leanness adds a fraction of the (minimum weight - chosen weight) delta. Changing any value here creates a NEW character version: bump master_character_id.
body_shape.chosen: Kiệt chose option A on 14/11/2026 (docs/exercise-visual-system/character_options_v3.png): 002 (muscle_definition 2.15) went past the strongest MakeHuman body and looked unnatural (traps up to the ears, shoulders 1.15x an average man). A stays inside the MakeHuman data range: maximum muscle, ideal proportions, local targets about half of 002. Option B was rejected: chest abnormally large.
body_shape.muscle_targets_comment: 005: body muscle targets only shape the MakeHuman base before sculpt_fit replaces the shape below the neck; the face targets are face 8b (Kiệt 23/11, picked from 13 renders: 7b looked too Asian).

faceless.comment: The frontal face (eyes, nose, mouth and their inner pockets) is cut out between the forehead and the chin and replaced by an evenly meshed surface. That surface is the front of the original head seen as a height field, with hollows narrower than fill_radius filled, bumps narrower than remove_radius removed, and a blur; it fades back into the original surface over rim_blend. Metres.

mannequin_head.comment: Kiệt 23/11 ("tỉ lệ nhân vật và cấu trúc nhân vật và mọi thứ liên quan đến nhân vật đều giống demic"): the whole head is a smooth egg like a studio fitness mannequin (no ears, nose or brow), a little smaller than the anatomical head. evs/character.mannequin_head.

base_subdivision_comment: 23/11: one level of subdivision applied to the base mesh before the muscle sculpt (evs/character.densify); rig.subdivision_render_levels lowered 2 -> 1 so the exported mesh keeps its size.

rig.comment: 53 game deform bones (Unreal-style names) plus anatomical helper bones from MPFB's default rig (14/11): shoulder blades, pectorals and twist bones, so the shoulder girdle and chest move like a real body and later exercises (rows, pull-ups, presses, curls) have the bones they need. Control bones (ctl_) and helper bones (mch_) are added by evs/rig.py and are never exported.

helper_bones.comment: Corrective helper bones (evs/helper_bones.py), Kiệt 15/11: traps get their own bone that follows the clavicle, and every deep-bending joint gets a half-rotation fold bone so the skin does not collapse or get dragged by the neighbouring group. Deform bones, constraint driven, exported (baked) like the twist bones.

folds.name: shoulder_fold_{s}
folds.why: The glenoid is on the shoulder blade and the deltoid arises from the scapular spine, acromion and clavicle, so the shoulder fold rides on the scapula (upward rotation) and turns half as far as the arm.
folds.why_target: 16/11: copies the swing bone, not the arm, so the fold does not carry 60% of the arm twist onto the shoulder.

folds.name: thumb_fold_{s}
folds.why: The thenar web between thumb and index finger stretched 5x in every grip: the skin there was split between the hand and the second thumb bone.

folds.name: wrist_fold_{s}
folds.why: ROM audit 15/11: wrist flexion/extension stretched the wrist skin 1.4-1.7x between forearm and hand.

folds.name: ankle_fold_{s}
folds.why: ROM audit 15/11: plantarflexion stretched the front of the ankle 1.4-1.9x.

folds.name: neck_fold
folds.why: ROM audit 15/11: neck flexion/rotation stretched the base of the neck 1.4-1.9x.

smooth.name: crotch
smooth.why: The pelvis-to-thigh switch sat on a 4 mm strip at the midline, so 90 deg of hip flexion tore it 8-12x. Skin stretch across a fold is about arc length over band width; spreading the switch over 8 cm each side keeps it under 2.6x (measured on the seated press, 15/11).

attach.name: scapula_skin_{s}
attach.why: Skin over the shoulder blade moves with the scapula (it slides over the ribs); 15/11 ROM audit: weighted to the upper spine it stayed behind and stretched 2.7x when the arm was raised with the scapulohumeral rhythm. The share ramps from 0 at the spine (x 0.02) to full at the medial border of the scapula (x 0.10): the interscapular skin shares the stretch instead of one seam (15/11 ROM re-test: a narrow ramp moved the 2.7x seam inward and made it 3.2x).

attach.name: front_chest_{s}
attach.why: The chest and the front of the armpit lie on the pectoralis major, which the arm pulls; the game rig weighted them to spine_03. The share ramps from 0 at x 0.08 to 0.8 at x 0.15 so there is no new seam (15/11 ROM audit).

attach.name: lat_skin_{s}
attach.why: 24/11: the flank under the armpit (lats, teres major, serratus) rides partly on lat_fold so it stretches with the raised arm instead of bunching; soft edges so no new seam.

follow_bones.name: chest_fold_{s}
follow_bones.why: The pectoralis major runs from the sternum to the humerus, so the arm pulls the chest: this bone turns a quarter of the arm's motion and carries the chest skin near the armpit (15/11 ROM audit).
follow_bones.why_target: 16/11: the pectoralis follows the arm direction; the humeral twist must not twist the chest skin.

follow_bones.name: lat_fold_{s}
follow_bones.why: 24/11 (Kiệt asked to fix the armpit): latissimus dorsi and teres major insert on the humerus, so raising the arm stretches the side of the chest upward. Character 005's sculpted lats flare wider than MakeHuman's torso, got spine weights and bunched into a lump with a sharp crease under the raised arm.
follow_bones.why_target: swing bone: the arm's twist must not twist the flank.
follow_bones.tried: 24/11: 0.5 (+share 0.65, z to 1.34) made a new lump low on the flank and stretch 3.51 vs 3.13 at 0.35

swing.name: upperarm_swing_{s}
swing.why: Squat 16/11: the bar grip turns the upper arm ~108 deg about its own axis (external rotation). The rig had no twist split at the shoulder, so the deltoid, chest and trapezius skin weighted to the arm took the whole twist and ballooned. Swing-only bone (Damped Track to the elbow): skin from the shoulder (t 0.05) to mid-arm (t 0.6) moves onto it, so the twist ramps from 0 at the shoulder to full at the elbow.
swing.why_fade: 16/11 ROM: fading over t 0.05-0.6 of the arm bone only left the twist bone (t 0.25-1) at full twist, so the twist jumped mid-arm (arm across the chest 1.59 -> 2.10). Fading both groups over the whole humerus spreads the twist evenly, 0 at the shoulder to full at the elbow, like the forearm twist between the radius and ulna.
swing.why_segments: 16/11 Kiệt: "tay nhìn teo". A single swing-to-arm blend shrank the mid upper arm 39 % (56 -> 34 mm radius, LBS candy wrapper). A 4-step twist ladder (0, 25, 50, 75, 100 %) keeps neighbouring frames 27 deg apart.

grip.comment: The standard bar grip of this character: where a bar of this diameter sits in the palm when grip_l / grip_r is 1 (along_palm = metres from the wrist joint towards the knuckles; palm_depth = metres from the plane of the hand bones to the bar's surface; palm_surface = how far the skin of the hollow of the palm lies from that plane). The finger angles are solved once from these numbers when the rig is built: every finger closes onto the bar without its skin entering the bar or the palm. Exercises place their grip sockets with the same numbers, so hand and bar always agree. The pads of the palm are rigid in this rig, so the bar is set a few millimetres into them to stand for soft tissue pressed flat.

muscle_sculpt.comment: 005: the shape comes from the sculpt; procedural blocks off, light grooves in the normal map only.

sculpt_fit.comment: evs/sculpt_fit.py; attribution in the source folder.

graft.comment: evs/graft_body.py: the sculpt below the base of its neck + MakeHuman head and neck; groups and UVs transferred from the fitted MakeHuman body.

joint_weight_smooth._note: 24/11: shoulder box (armpit folds stretched 25x overhead) + spheres round hips and knees (seated groin lumps, knobby knees); see graft_body.smooth_joint_weights

neck_fair._note: 24/11 Kiệt: neck seam had a ring, then 'còn khấc' — bi-Laplacian fairing of the bridge band; graft_body.fair_neck

muscle_refit._note: 24/11 Kiệt: 'vẽ các nhóm cơ phải bám theo đúng nhóm cơ thật của charactor'. Watershed of the atlas borders onto the sculpt's grooves (AO + normal map); see evs/mask_refit.py.
